title: Claymorphism
description: Design brinquedo, bubbly, pastéis suaves e bordas chunky. Ideal para apps infantis e creative tools. Prompt playful.
use_case: Apps infantis, Creative tools, Educação, Jogos interativos
historical_context: 2021+ movimento ludic design, inspirado em Clay.io e Adobe XD. Rejeita corporate severity — celebra diversão, bubbly, toy-like.
cores_primarias: Pastel: Soft Peach #FDBCB4, Baby Blue #ADD8E6, Mint #98FF98, Lilac #E6E6FA, light BG
cores_secundarias: Soft gradients (pastel-to-pastel), light/dark variations (20-30%), gradient subtle
efeitos: Inner+outer shadows (subtle, no hard lines), soft press (200ms ease-out), fluffy elements, smooth transitions
